name: Trampoline park and indoor playground

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Open jump, 60 minutes, 4 jumpers
services.story: The main story: 4 open-jump passes, 60 minutes, $88 paid in full when booking.

services.name: Birthday party package, 10 jumpers
services.story: A birthday party package for 10 jumpers: a $100 deposit when booking, the $229 rest at the front desk on the day.

services.name: Field trip, 20 jumpers
services.story: A school field trip for 20 jumpers: nothing before, one bill to the school after.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Mobile play party, 2 hours
services.story: The main story: a mobile play party for 2 hours: $150, a $40 deposit, the $110 rest charged to the saved card when the team texts DONE.

services.name: Toddler party at home, 1 hour
services.story: A toddler party at home: $179, a card saved for the $89 fee; Rosie texts the bill after the party.

services.name: Toddler play at home, paid in full
services.story: A 1-hour toddler play at home, paid in full when booking: $75.

services_shape: table: timed jump sessions with a set number of jumpers per start time (a seat in a session), and party rooms booked for a set time (a space)
questions_before_times: which session or party, and the date and time
how many jumpers, and each one's age group (toddler, 6 to 12, teen, adult)
for a party: the expected number of jumpers
for a mobile party: the kind of place (a yard, a school, a park) and the town
safety_stop: someone hurt or unwell right now: a head or neck injury, a broken bone, trouble breathing, not waking up
first_steps: a waiver for every jumper, signed on the secure page before the visit, good for 12 months; a party's guests' parents sign on a link the host forwards
the party's final headcount by 3 days before (it sets the food and the rest due)
a field trip: the chaperone list and each child's waiver the day before
a mobile party: the customer confirms the flat area, the power outlet and any permission the place needs (a school's or a park's) 3 days before, and marks sprinkler and underground lines before setup
license: if: where the state's amusement-ride or trampoline court rules apply, the park holds the state's permit or registration and passes its inspections; elsewhere the business registration only; a mobile inflatable party follows the same state rules where they cover inflatables
staff_skills: court monitor, party host, mobile party attendant
messages_never: children's names, ages and health answers, and injury details: only on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
